GameSession.title: GameSession
GameSession.description: Active Sudoku game session state for a signed-in user.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level name (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, EXPERT, DAILY).

mistakes.description: Number of mistakes made in the current session.

isPaused.description: Whether the game timer is currently paused.

isDaily.description: Whether this session is a daily challenge.

boardData.description: Serialized 9x9 board cell values and flags.

notesData.description: Serialized pencil mark notes for each cell.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DailyChallenge.title: DailyChallenge
DailyChallenge.description: Completed daily Sudoku challenge record for a user.

completed.description: Whether the daily challenge was completed.

timeSpentSeconds.description: Duration taken to complete the challenge in seconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Sticker.title: Sticker
Sticker.description: Achievement sticker badge state for a user.

unlocked.description: Whether the user has unlocked this sticker.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when sticker entry was initialized (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when sticker was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

GameStats.title: GameStats
GameStats.description: Aggregated Sudoku statistics per difficulty for a user.

difficulty.description: Difficulty key (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, EXPERT, DAILY).

gamesPlayed.description: Total games played at this difficulty.

gamesWon.description: Total games won at this difficulty.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when stats record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when stats record was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
Leaderboard.description: Public realtime leaderboard record for a user.

username.description: Public display username chosen by user.

title.description: Honorary rank title (e.g. Grandmaster, Obsidian Solver).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last leaderboard update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores active Sudoku game session for the user.

/users/{userId}/daily_challenges/{dateSt.description: Stores daily challenge completion records by date for the user.

/users/{userId}/stickers/{stickerId}.description: Stores achievement stickers and unlock status for the user.

/users/{userId}/game_stats/{difficulty}.description: Stores per-difficulty game statistics for the user.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Stores realtime public leaderboard profile for each user.
